findings.builder_a_rule: builder 0x5cf2150 (409 B, shared by both gates) calls the descriptor accessor 0x5cf2b50 (slot 0x64e0848) and base-value callee 0x5c842e0(1), performs checked 1e9 / 946684800 arithmetic, asserts through slot 0x64df770 when a handle dword equals 1000000000, and writes only S+0x00 (accessor rax), S+0x08 (accessor rdx), S+0x10 := 2, S+0x60 (computed value) and S+0x68 (dword). The rest of S is initialised by the predicate normalisation.
findings.checker_a_layout: arg+0x00 f64 value v (read); arg+0x08 f64 copy of v (written by the state-0 arm); arg+0x10 f64 copy of v / re-entry value source; arg+0x18..0x88 the 0x70-byte built struct S (builder output, then predicate input); arg+0x88 sub-state byte; arg+0x90 state byte.
findings.checker_a_question: checker_a is a resumable state machine over a 0x98-byte sub-object (arg = rdi). In gate_c it runs on two instances of the same kind: arg = record+0x150 (state-4 arm call at gate_c 0x2cbb717) and arg = record+0xd8 (r14-phase call at 0x2cb9923).
findings.checker_a_return_rule: State byte [arg+0x90]: 0 = fresh, 3 = resume, 1 and 2 are trap arms (location-static shims 0x1681e80 / 0x1681e60 from base/src/lu.rs statics, then ud2). Fresh arm: v := [arg+0x00]; [arg+0x08] := v. If v == +-0.0: [arg+0x90] := 1 and return 0 (the [arg+0x88] byte is NOT written on this path). If v < 0: panic through slot 0x64df6b8 with the base/src/bucket_guard.rs format pieces at 0x43b857 and dl = 0; NaN reaches the same panic with dl = 1. If v > 0 finite: v is decomposed (biased exponent, 1e9-unit scaling) into the (rsi, rdx) inputs of builder 0x5cf2150 (slot 0x64e13a0, descriptor static 0x644dc28); the 0x70-byte result is copied into S = [arg+0x18..0x88) and predicate 0x5cf2d30 (slot 0x64e0858) runs on S with the caller context. Predicate nonzero: [arg+0x88] := 3, [arg+0x90] := 3, return the predicate eax (nonzero). Predicate zero: the handle pair is dropped (refcount dec on [arg+0x20]; drop fn chosen by byte [arg+0x18] between slots 0x64dfdc8 / 0x64dfdb8; drop_pair 0x2ca0790 on &[arg+0x28]), [arg+0x88] := 1, [arg+0x90] := 1, return 0. Resume arm ([arg+0x90] == 3) dispatches on [arg+0x88]: 0 re-runs builder+predicate from v = [arg+0x10] (no copy, no state zeroing), 3 calls the predicate directly on the existing S, 1 and 2 trap. EH pads drop &[arg+0x28] and the bodies at &[arg+0x18] / &[arg+0x10], write state 2 to [arg+0x88] and [arg+0x90], and _Unwind_Resume.
findings.checker_b_layout: arg+0x00..0x20 source descriptor D {cap +0x00, ptr +0x08, len +0x10, tag byte +0x18}; arg+0x20..0x40 the working copy of D; arg+0x40 pointer slot holding &[arg+0x20]; arg+0x48..0x68 built key struct B {len +0x48, buffer +0x50, len +0x58, tag +0x60}; arg+0x68 / +0x78 the constant &str pair (0x451330, 16) written twice ("async_wait_inner"); arg+0x88 the handle object pointer written by keyhash_b; arg+0x90 / +0x98 / +0xa0 state bytes.
findings.checker_b_question: checker_b is a resumable state machine over a 0xa8-byte sub-object (arg = record+0x128 in gate_c). It turns the source byte string at arg+0x00 into a registry-backed handle and polls it once per call.
findings.checker_b_return_rule: Entry dispatch on [arg+0xa0]; states 1 and 2 trap. The fresh arm copies D to [arg+0x20..0x40), stores [arg+0x40] := &[arg+0x20] and [arg+0x98] := 0; the resume arm dispatches on [arg+0x98], whose state-0 arm reloads the descriptor through [arg+0x40]. The string bytes are copied to a fresh allocation (allocator slot 0x64df480, memcpy slot 0x64df508; len 0 uses sentinel buffer 1), B is built, the constant name pair is written, [arg+0x90] := 0, and keyhash_b 0x2b3c9d0 (direct call at 0x2c7fb66) stores a heap handle at [arg+0x88]. lookup_b 0x2e4adb0 (0x2c7fb84) then polls: it presets the result tag qword to 1 and calls the vtable method [handle+0x10]+0x18 = 0x2b15630. The method returns without writing when its readiness callee (slot 0x64dfe80 -> 0x5cdb250, on &[obj+0x60]) returns 0, leaving tag 1; when ready it requires [obj+0x38] == 1 (else the "JoinHandle polled after completion" panic at 0x6068d2), sets [obj+0x38] := 2 and writes result {tag 0, payload triple from obj+0x40..0x58}. lookup_b also forces tag 1 on its TLS fast path. checker_b returns 1 (bit 0 set, all three state bytes := 3, second return value = the caller context) when the result tag byte != 0, and returns 0 when the tag is 0: it then CAS-transitions the handle state word 0xcc -> 0x84 (contention calls the vtable drop 0x2b19230), consumes the payload triple through helper 0x2c7f720 (callback fn 0x24a7c50; its rax becomes checker_b second return value in rdx), sets all state bytes := 1 and frees the source descriptor buffer when [arg+0x20] != 0. EH pads drop B (0x2c93260) and the [arg+0x40] descriptor (0x2ca6960), free the source buffer, write state 2 to all three state bytes and _Unwind_Resume. Re-entry through sub-state [arg+0x98] == 3 dispatches on [arg+0x90]: state 0 reloads the constant pair from [arg+0x68] / [arg+0x70] and rejoins the keyhash phase with the previously built B.
findings.clone_verdict: The gate_a clones are logic-identical to the gate_c originals. All five relative jump tables reproduce the original arm offsets exactly (checker_a +0x2e/+0x304/+0x2f7/+0x4d and +0x6f/+0x320/+0x311/+0x287; checker_b +0x2b/+0x244/+0x237/+0x56, +0x78/+0x275/+0x261/+0x1fe, +0x22a/+0x298/+0x289/+0x132), the normalised instruction streams are equal, and the decision callees are shared bodies (builder 0x5cf2150 and predicate 0x5cf2d30 via the same slots; keyhash_b 0x2b3c9d0 and lookup_b 0x2e4adb0 by the same direct calls). The only per-family differences are family-local drop glue: checker_b payload helper 0x2c7f720 vs clone 0x2a90e10 (both 227 B, normalised-equal), drop_pair 0x2ca0790 vs 0x2abc7e0, and the EH drop bodies (gate_c 0x2c8b730 96 B / 0x2ca4700 114 B / 0x2c93260 62 B / 0x2ca6960 69 B; gate_a analogues 0x2a9e950 96 B / 0x2ac0e00 114 B / 0x2aaab40 62 B / 0x2ac30e0 69 B), plus each clone its own jump tables and location statics.
findings.keyhash_b_rule: keyhash_b 0x2b3c9d0 (742 B, shared) resolves the location descriptor (static 0x644dbe0) through accessor 0x5cf2b50, takes the spinlock on global word 0x64fee40 (pointer from slot 0x64e16c0), builds a 0x100-byte object on the stack {state 0xcc at +0x00, vtable 0x6449b00 at +0x10, registry refcount/value at +0x20/+0x28, B copied in}, allocates it via slot 0x64df590 -> 0x63577f0, inserts it into one of two registry slots through slot 0x64e7718 -> 0x5cf5100 (a duplicate insert panics with the "OS can't spawn worker thread: " pieces at 0x431a60) and returns the heap object pointer.
findings.precise_negatives: Not statically decidable from these bodies: (1) which callee inside the predicate post-check chain overwrites the -1 sentinel at S+0x38 (the conversion 0x5cead40 and the slot-0x64e0518 callee 0x5ce91b0 both run between the sentinel store and the decision read; their internals are not pinned here). (2) The semantic identity of method_b readiness callee 0x5cdb250 beyond its (obj, &[obj+0x60]) -> al contract. (3) The producer of the caller-supplied struct that gate_c copies into rec+0x118..0x158 at 0x2cb7225 (outside the gate body). (4) The pre-first-call value of [rec+0x1d8] (no writer inside the gates or the shapers).
findings.predicate_a_rule: predicate 0x5cf2d30 (703 B, shared) first consults a TLS cache (TLS-0x1130; guard slot 0x64e0510): if the TLS u16 low bit is set and its high byte is 0 it calls slot 0x64e0520 -> 0x5cf3b90 (context, static 0x64c6648) and returns 1. Otherwise, when [S+0x10] == 2, it normalises S: refcount-inc on [S+0x08], conversion 0x5cf1d70 on &[S+0x10], [S+0x18] := handle, [S+0x20..0x38) := 0, [S+0x38] := -1, [S+0x40] := 0, [S+0x50] := 0, byte [S+0x58] := 0, then conversion 0x5cead40(&[S+0x10], [S+0x60], dword [S+0x68]). Decision: if dword [handle + (tag&1 ? 0x160 : 0x240) + 0x90] == 1000000000 -> assert-fail (slot 0x64df770) and ud2; else if byte [handle + base + 0x80] != 0 -> panic with the bucket_guard "$min > max" pieces and ud2; else call slot 0x64e0518 -> 0x5ce91b0 on &[S+0x40] (result unused), then return 1 iff [S+0x38] != -1; return 0 iff [S+0x38] == -1 and byte [S+0x58] == 0; [S+0x38] == -1 with [S+0x58] != 0 unwinds through the "timer error: " format piece at 0x433ed3 (not a normal return). So checker_a returns nonzero exactly when the predicate fast path fires or the normalised struct carries a converted value at S+0x38 after the post-check call.
findings.producer_census: gate_c writes the tested fields itself, in the phases that immediately precede the calls; the shapers write none of them (the #2604 bracket census records no shaper access at the phase offsets of record+0x128 / +0x150 / +0x1d8 / +0x1e0). Per field: (a) checker_b source triple [rec+0x130 ptr / +0x138 len / +0x140 tag byte] - on entry rounds it arrives through the verbatim 0x40-byte copy at gate_c 0x2cb7225..0x2cb7255 that fills rec+0x118..0x158 from a caller-supplied struct (*rax): gate-copied, not gate-computed; its producer outside the gate is the boundary. In the funnel round the gate overwrites +0x128 (f64 store 0x2cbb552), +0x130 (f64 store 0x2cbb610), +0x138..+0x148 and +0x148 (0x2cbb69e / 0x2cbb68e, from the slot-0x64df6e8 descriptor call) - but those stores land AFTER the 0x2cbb490 checker_b call of the same arm. (b) checker_a f64 [rec+0x150]: exactly one gate store, 0x2cbb6f9, copying the gate-computed double at [rec+0x130] (clamped computation from [rec+0xa8] via slot 0x64e7460, constants 2.0 / -1.0 / 600.0) - gate-built. (c) checker_a state bytes: [rec+0x1e0] zeroed by the gate at 0x2cbb701 immediately before the call; [rec+0x1d8] has NO gate store - it is written only by checker_a itself, so its pre-first-call value is incoming record residue. (d) the +0xd8 instance: the gate stores the f64 constant 86400000000.0 (bits 0x42341dd760000000) at [rec+0xd8] at 0x2cb990d and zeroes its state byte [rec+0x168] at 0x2cb9914 - gate-built; its [arg+0x88] byte at rec+0x160 is written by checker_a itself and, in one other phase, by the gate store at 0x2cb73e0 (paired with [rec+0x168] at 0x2cb73ed). The two checker_a instances are staggered by 0x78 bytes, so instance fields alias: rec+0x160 / +0x168 are both the +0xd8 instance state bytes and the +0x150 instance [arg+0x10] / S+0x00.
findings.r14_phase_call: At gate_c 0x2cb98fc, r14 := lea [rbx+0xd8]; the gate stores the f64 constant 86400000000.0 at [rbx+0xd8] (0x2cb9903 / 0x2cb990d), zeroes [rbx+0x170] (r15 target) and [rbx+0x168], then calls checker_a at 0x2cb9923 with rdi = r14 and rsi = the context spill [rsp+0x8]. It is the same sub-object kind as the +0x150 instance: the zero path tests [rbx+0x168] == 3 and [rbx+0x160] == 3 (its [arg+0x90] / [arg+0x88]), drops the handle pair at [rbx+0xf8] with the tag byte at [rbx+0xf0] (its S+0x00 / S+0x08) and calls drop_pair 0x2ca0790 on &[rbx+0x100] (its &[arg+0x28]) at 0x2cb9985, exactly mirroring checker_a internal layout; a nonzero return sets [rbx+0x170] := 3 and joins the funnel mid-tail at 0x2cb802d with outcome 4; a zero return sets [rbx+0x170] := 1, calls cleanup 0x2ca3ab0 on &[rbx+0xd8] and reaches the return-0 arm at 0x2cb99a7.
